items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: And then I left him and went and learnt more my reading, like the music part, from my shallow knee.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I had my first few lessons from him. And then I left him and went and learnt more my reading, like the music part, from my shallow knee. He was an old mail carrier at the time. He was in his sixties during the time, he and I did. Yeah.
